gates.closure: find_strings_packages admits only cleanly-closing packages (ok + len>=2); ring 8 re-read must also close with residual 0 or the package is dropped from the vocabulary — both gates enforced per package
gates.magnitudes: ring 19 registered 7,975 (3604) -> 8,273 (4655) questions on this board; the string-id counts here are the STRING layer, expected larger and not equal by definition

honesty: SCSU texts decode via ring 8's UTS#6 implementation; placeholder-free by construction (rings 7-8 closed that ledger)
strings shared across MANY modules are counted once per module and once globally — both layers are registered
DUP (0x20) resolutions follow ring 8 (dup of already-decoded id); unresolved dups keep their placeholder
